title: Zero Water
body: No sprinklers, no borehole schedules, no dry patches in winter. Once installed, the lawn needs no irrigation at all.
label: 0 L

title: Climate Ready
short: UV-stabilised for high-altitude sun and coastal salt air.
body: Turf engineered for Gauteng’s high-altitude sun and Cape Town’s coastal salt air, so colour and fibre hold up season after season.
label: UV

title: All-Weather Drainage
short: No pooling after summer storms or winter rain.
body: Built to handle Gauteng summer downpours and Cape Town winter rain without pooling.

title: Our Own Team
body: Every project is scoped, supplied and installed by our own team — one point of accountability from site visit to handover.

title: Warranties in Writing
short: Up to 6-year product warranty + 24-month workmanship guarantee.
body: A manufacturer’s product warranty of up to 6 years (5 on Deco and Multisport) and a 24-month workmanship / installation guarantee on every installation.
